name: Johann Peter Grub

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To Maria Amalia Grill (1726-1759); children born at Offenbach 1750 and 1752; second wife Magdalena c.1759

bioAdditions: FamilySearch places Johann Peter in Johann Nickel Grub's family, which supports his being Andreas's brother. It gives his birth at Jettenbach on 29 Feb 1724 (baptized at Reichenbach on 5 Mar 1724) and his marriage at Offenbach am Glan on 2 Jan 1749 to Maria Amalia Grill, with children born at Offenbach in 1750 and 1752, just before the 1753 Windsor voyage. It also gives a second wife, Magdalena, about 1759, the 1800 census as 'Peter Krub', and his death on 24 Aug 1802 (S1).

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Johann Peter Grub (KNZ7-5V6), with attached index entries
